value.name: feels brass latch cold
value.description: She rests her hand on Whitfield's door latch and notices the cold brass under her thumb.
evidence: t her other hand on the latch of Whitfield's door, registering the small cold of the brass under her thumb

value.name: ignores repeated phone alert
value.description: She lets a buzzing phone alert go unanswered instead of checking it.
evidence: let the buzz that followed, a second alert or the same one repeating, pass without lifting the phone to check

value.name: picks up briefcase by handle
value.description: She takes the briefcase from the chair and deliberately carries it by the handle rather than the spine.
evidence: The briefcase was still on the chair beside her, and she picked it up by the handle rather than the spine

value.name: remembers prior carrying choice
value.description: She reflects that carrying the briefcase by the spine in the car had been a different decision.
evidence: because the spine was what she had carried it by in the car and that had been a different decision

value.name: opens Whitfield's door
value.description: She pushes Whitfield's door fully open and enters the room.
evidence: Then she pushed the door the rest of the way open and went in

value.name: leaves Devin's message unanswered
value.description: She enters the room while leaving Devin's message unread and unanswered on her phone.
evidence: leaving Devin's message unanswered on a screen no one in the room would see
